roots.origin: 拉丁语 auctor（创造者、发起者），来自 augere（增长、使兴旺）——能令事物产生并发展的人
roots.core_concept: the one who brings something into being, the source of authority / 使事物产生的人，权威的来源
roots.core_image: 工匠亲手打造出第一件器物，后来者都来仿照它

roots.origin: 拉丁语 clarus（明亮、清晰、响亮），与古英语 clear 同源
roots.core_concept: bright and clear, easy to see or hear / 明亮清晰、一望即明
roots.core_image: 雨后天晴，远山的轮廓在明净空气里一线分明

roots.origin: 拉丁语 crescere（生长、增多、壮大）
roots.core_concept: to grow, to swell in size or number / 生长、增多、壮大
roots.core_image: 幼苗在雨后一节节拔高，从土里冒出新叶

roots.origin: 拉丁语 gerere（携带、承载、进行）
roots.core_concept: to carry, to bear and convey / 携带、承载并把某物传递过去
roots.core_image: 信使把一封沉甸甸的信揣在怀里，从一处送到另一处

concepts.concept: one who originates, the growing source of authority
concepts.core_image: 工匠打成第一件器物，众人以它为准则
雨后初晴，远山轮廓在明净空气中一线分明

concepts.concept: to grow larger in size or number
concepts.core_image: 雨后幼苗一节节拔高、抽出新叶

concepts.concept: to carry and convey, bearing meaning along
concepts.core_image: 信使把信揣在怀里从一处送到另一处

words.root_logic: auth（使产生）+ -or（人）→ 使作品产生的人 → 作者
words.origin: 拉丁语 auctor（创造者、发起者），经古法语 autor 入英语
words.native_definition: a person who writes a book or article, or creates something
words.core_concept: the one who brings a work into being – 使一部作品得以产生的人
words.core_image: 书桌上摊开的稿纸旁，执笔人刚刚落下最后一个句号
examples: The author signed copies of her novel.
He is the author of the plan.
semantic_expansions: 作者/著者：使作品产生的人
创始人：使某种做法或机构产生的人
words.recall_hint: auth（使产生）+ -or → 使作品产生的人

words.root_logic: auth（源头可靠）→ 出自可信源头的、非伪造的
words.origin: 希腊语 authentikos（原始的、可信的），经拉丁语 authenticus 入英语
words.native_definition: real, genuine, and not a copy or fake
words.core_concept: traceable to the true origin, not an imitation – 能追溯到真实源头、非仿制
words.core_image: 博物馆里那幅画经鉴定出自画家本人之手，笔触与署名都对得上
examples: The museum displayed an authentic painting.
The dish uses authentic spices.
semantic_expansions: 真实的/正宗的：可追溯到真实源头、非伪造
words.recall_hint: auth（源头）→ 追得到可靠源头 → 真实可信

words.root_logic: auth（使产生）+ -ority → 使事物产生并定夺的那份力量
words.origin: 拉丁语 auctoritas（权威、影响力），来自 auctor（创造者）
words.native_definition: the power to make decisions or give orders; a reliable source of information
words.core_concept: the originating power that settles things – 能定夺事物、源头可靠的那份力量
words.core_image: 裁判手中的哨子一响，场上争执即刻平息
examples: The police have authority to enforce the law.
She is an authority on ancient art.
semantic_expansions: 权威/权力：能定夺事物、让人信服的源头力量
当局：行使权力的一方机构
words.recall_hint: auth（使产生）+ -ority → 能定夺的源头力量 → 权威

words.root_logic: clar（清晰）+ -ify（使）→ 使思绪或说法变得清楚明白
words.origin: 拉丁语 clarificare（使明亮），来自 clarus（清晰的）
words.native_definition: to make something easier to understand, or to make a liquid clear
words.core_concept: making murkiness bright until it is plainly seen – 把浑浊之处照亮直到看得分明
words.core_image: 浑浊的水静置后慢慢变清，杯底杂质沉下去
examples: Could you clarify what you meant?
The liquid clarified overnight.
semantic_expansions: 澄清/阐明：把含混之处说清楚
words.recall_hint: clar（清晰）+ -ify（使）→ 使变得清楚

words.root_logic: clar（清晰）+ -ity（名词）→ 清楚明白的状态
words.origin: 拉丁语 claritas（明亮），来自 clarus（清晰的）
words.native_definition: the quality of being clear and easy to understand or see
words.core_concept: the bright state of being plainly seen – 一眼看明的明亮状态
words.core_image: 晨光下的湖面映出岸边每棵树的倒影，根根分明
examples: The report was praised for its clarity.
Water clarity improved after the rain.
semantic_expansions: 清晰/清澈：一目了然的明亮状态
words.recall_hint: clar（清晰）+ -ity → 清楚明白的状态

words.root_logic: de-（完全）+ clar（清晰）→ 把话说得完全清楚 → 公开宣布
words.origin: 拉丁语 declarare（使完全清晰），来自 de＋clarus
words.native_definition: to announce something officially or publicly
words.core_concept: speaking a matter fully clear before all – 当着众人把话说到完全明白
words.core_image: 主持人走到台前，把最终结果一字一句念给全场
examples: The government declared a state of emergency.
You must declare any gifts at customs.
semantic_expansions: 宣布/声明：公开把话说清楚
words.recall_hint: de-（完全）+ clar（清晰）→ 说得全然明白 → 宣布

words.root_logic: in-（向内）+ crease（生长）→ 向内积聚地生长 → 增多
words.origin: 拉丁语 increscere（生长其中），来自 in＋crescere
words.native_definition: to become or make greater in size, number, or degree
words.core_concept: growing inward and upward until there is more – 生长累积直到数量变大
words.core_image: 雪球从山顶滚下，越滚越大、越滚越快
examples: The price of oil increased sharply.
Sales show an increase this quarter.
semantic_expansions: 增加/增长：数量或程度生长变大
words.recall_hint: in-（向内）+ crease（生长）→ 向内生长变多

words.root_logic: de-（向下）+ crease（生长）→ 生长势头向下走 → 减少
words.origin: 拉丁语 decrescere（减少），来自 de＋crescere
words.native_definition: to become or make smaller in size, number, or degree
words.core_concept: growing in the downward direction, lessening – 朝下生长的方向收缩变小
words.core_image: 退潮时水位一寸寸落下去，露出更多滩涂
examples: The number of visitors decreased last year.
There was a decrease in accidents.
semantic_expansions: 减少/下降：生长的势头向下收缩
words.recall_hint: de-（向下）+ crease（生长）→ 生长朝下走 → 减少

words.root_logic: increase（增多）+ -ingly（副词）→ 以日益增多的方式
words.native_definition: more and more; to an ever greater degree
words.core_concept: growing all the while, more with each step – 一直生长、一步比一步更多
words.core_image: 天色渐暗，路灯一盏接一盏亮起，街上人流愈密
examples: Life there is becoming increasingly expensive.
She increasingly prefers quiet evenings.
semantic_expansions: 越来越/日益：程度随生长不断加大

words.root_logic: gest（携带）+ -ure → 用手臂'携带'意思的动作
words.origin: 拉丁语 gestura（举止、姿态），来自 gerere（携带、做）
words.native_definition: a movement of the body that expresses meaning
words.core_concept: carrying meaning with one's body instead of words – 不用言语、用身体把意思带出去
words.core_image: 老人竖起大拇指，无需开口，赞许便送到了对方眼前
examples: She made a gesture of welcome.
Thumbs up is a universal gesture.
semantic_expansions: 手势/姿态：用身体携带并传递意思的动作
words.recall_hint: gest（携带）+ -ure → 用手势把意思带出去

words.root_logic: sug-（sub- 从下）+ gest（携带）→ 从底层悄悄带上来的意思 → 暗示
words.origin: 拉丁语 suggerere（从下面带上、提示），来自 sub＋gerere
words.native_definition: to put forward an idea for consideration, or imply something indirectly
words.core_concept: carrying an idea up from below, softly offering it – 从下方悄悄把想法带上来给人看
words.core_image: 桌下轻轻踢了一脚，话不必说出口意思已经到了
examples: I suggest we leave early.
His tone suggested doubt.
semantic_expansions: 建议：把想法带上台面供人考虑
暗示：不直说而把意思带出来
words.recall_hint: sug-（从下）+ gest（携带）→ 悄悄带上来的意思 → 暗示

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 分开）+ gest（携带）→ 把食物分开携带走 → 消化
words.origin: 拉丁语 digerere（分开、分配），来自 dis＋gerere
words.native_definition: to break down food in the body, or absorb information
words.core_concept: carrying food apart and away into the body – 把食物拆开并分别带走、吸收利用
words.core_image: 胃里像一座小磨坊，把吃下的东西慢慢磨碎化开
examples: The body digests food slowly.
It takes time to digest the news.
semantic_expansions: 消化：把食物拆开带走为身体所用
领会：把信息慢慢吸收理解
文摘：把大量内容压缩携带的读物
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ gest（携带）→ 把食物分开带走 → 消化
